title: Not as blue as the pics, but still nice.
text: Not as blue as the pics, but still nice.. The blue is slightly darker/paler than I'd like, but still a nice blue. The gray and blue go well with our beige couch. The fabric definitely has that rougher, farmhouse feel, which is exactly what I wanted.
